parts.name: Button
parts.Basic_description: This is the button of a retractable pen, made of plastic and located at the top end of the pen.
parts.Functional_description: It is used to extend or retract the pen tip by pressing it, controlling the writing mechanism inside.
parts.Movement_description: It moves vertically when pressed and released, engaging an internal spring mechanism.

parts.name: Base Body
parts.Basic_description: This is the main body of the pen, made of plastic, forming the cylindrical structure that houses the ink cartridge.
parts.Functional_description: It provides the main grip area for writing and holds the internal ink refill and mechanism.
parts.Movement_description: It remains stationary during use, serving as the structural and ergonomic support for the pen.
